blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Semantic 3D mapping is a powerful representation that enables platform agnostic mobile robot navigation in challenging offroad conditions. Current vision foundation models can accurately predict semantics zero-shot on structured scenes but performance is compromised in natural environments. On the other hand, 3D point clouds encode valuable information for discriminating semantics in scenarios where vision foundation models fail. In this work, we propose fitting a sphericity-elevation distribution for each semantic class to act as geometric anchor. Only the points with the most confident vision foundation model predictions are considered when fitting to produce high quality geometric prior distributions. The geometric prior is fused with the vision foundation model prediction to produce the final semantic mapping. The proposed prior improves SAM3 baseline by +6.3 in mIoU and +8.9 in accuracy on the RELLIS-3D dataset, and by +1.7 in mIoU and +2.1 in accuracy on the WildScenes dataset. The source code will be made public upon paper acceptance.
blocks.zh: 语义3D映射是一种强大的代表,它能够在挑战越野条件下实现平台不可知的移动机器人导航. 目前的视觉基础模型可以准确预测结构化场景中的语义学零镜头,但在自然环境中性能受损. 另一方面,3D点云为在视觉基础模型失败的情景中区分语义的有价值的信息编码. 在这部作品中,我们提议为每个语义类配配一个球形-外延分布,作为几何锚. 只有最有自信的视觉基础模型预测的点才在适合产生高质量的几何前分布时加以考虑. 几何前缀与视觉基础模型预测结合,产生最终的语义映射. 拟议之前的SAM3基线在 RELLIS-3D 数据集上改进了+6.3 mIoU 和+8.9 准确度,在 WildScens 数据集上改进+1.7 mIoU 和+2.1 准确度. 原始代码将在接受纸面后公布。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Semantic understanding of the environment is crucial for autonomous navigation in offroad conditions. Most offroad research concentrates on traversability estimation that reduces the rich geometry and semantic information to single dimension [ 1 , 2 ] . These methods commonly classify any elevated 3D points as non-traversable and cannot accurately reason about the passability of different types of vegetation. Semantic 3D perception would provide more flexible foundation for offroad navigation that can be easily adapted to different scenarios and platforms.
blocks.zh: 对环境的语义理解对于在越野条件下自主通航至关重要. 大多数外出研究集中于可转性估计,将丰富的几何和语义信息减少为单维[1,2]. 这些方法通常将任何提升的3D分被归类为不可逆,无法准确解释不同类型植被的可通过性. 语义上3D感知能为可以轻松地适应不同情景和平台的越野导航提供更灵活的基础.

blocks.en: While the current foundation models for general purpose segmentation [ 3 , 4 ] achieve impressive accuracy on structured environments their performance is significantly lower on unstructured natural scenes. Separating different kinds of vegetation and terrain from images is one of the major challenges as there are no clear visual boundaries. At the same time correct classification of different vegetation and terrain types is critical for succesful navigation decisions as they cover significant portion of natural scenes and have different traversability properties.
blocks.zh: 虽然目前通用分解的基础模型[3,4]在结构化环境中取得了令人印象深刻的准确性,但在结构化的自然场景上其性能却明显较低. 将不同种类的植被和地形从图像中分离出来,是主要的挑战之一,因为没有明显的视觉界限. 同时,对不同植被和地形类型进行正确分类对于顺利的导航决定至关重要,因为它们覆盖了相当一部分自然场景,具有不同的可转性。

blocks.en: Different terrain and vegetation types typically have distinctive geometric features that can help image based foundation models discriminate between them. We propose utilizing elevation and sphericity computed from lidar point clouds for this task. Elevation separates the terrain from vegetation and obstacles above it. Sphericity discriminates between different terrain and vegetation types based on their local shape. We fit an elevation-sphericity histogram for each semantic class based on the most confident detections from the vision foundation model to act as an geometric anchor. We then place prior for each point by comparing its elevation and sphericity to the fitted histograms. This prior is fused with the vision foundation model prediction to produce the final estimate. The proposed method yields significant improvements over vision foundation model baselines when evaluated with two real-world offroad datasets: Rellis3d [ 5 ] and WildScenes [ 6 ] . The main contributions are:
blocks.zh: 不同的地貌和植被类型通常具有独特的几何特征,可以帮助基于图像的地基模型在它们之间有所区别. 我们建议利用从立达点云计算出来的高地和球面来完成这项任务。 高地将地势与植被及其上方的障碍相分离. 球形根据其地貌区分出不同的地貌和植被类型. 我们为每个语义类安装一个高程-球形直方图, 其依据是视觉基础模型中最有把握的检测结果, 以作为几何锚地。 然后,我们将每个点放在前面,将其高地和球面与安装的直方图进行比较。 此前置与视觉基础模型预测相接以得出最后估计。 采用Rellis3d [5]和WildScees两个现实世界离地数据集进行评价后,拟议方法比愿景基础模型基线有重大改进 [6]. 主要贡献是:

blocks.en: • Novel elevation-sphericity histogram based prior for 3D semantic segmentation in offroad environments • Demonstration of significant improvements in both mIoU and accuracy with real-world offroad datasets. • Open-source implementation to support future development

blocks.en: II Related work
blocks.zh: 二. 有关工作

blocks.en: II-A Vision foundation models for zero-shot semantic segmentation
blocks.zh: II-A 零发语义分解的远景基础模型

blocks.en:
Historically, segmentation models have been trained on task- and domain-specific datasets to achieve reliable performance within that domain.
The current trend is to pretrain large vision models on massive, diverse datasets using self-supervised, weakly supervised, or multimodal objectives, and then adapt them to a variety of downstream tasks and domains with minimal additional training. These models are referred to as vision foundation models. Thanks to extensive pre-training many vision foundation models can be used in zero-shot manner, meaning they require no training in the target domain to perform inference. Variety of vision foundation models have been proposed in recent years. DINO [ 7 ] and EVA [ 8 ] are popular examples of feature extraction backbones that can be fine tuned for variety of downstream tasks. SAM [ 9 ] and Grounded SAM [ 10 ] are designed for the segmentation task. Large vision language models like Gemini [ 11 ] and Qwen VL [ 12 ] support image inputs but they are trained for higher level image understanding and reasoning not pixel level segmentation task.
blocks.zh:
从历史上看,分解模型已经接受了任务和域特有数据集的培训,以便在域内实现可靠的性能.
目前的趋势是利用自我监督、监督不力或多式联运目标,在大规模、多样化的数据集上预先培训大型远景模型,然后将其适应各种下游任务和领域,尽量减少额外培训。 这些模型被称为愿景基础模型. 由于培训前的广泛性,许多视觉基础模型可以零镜头的方式使用,这意味着它们不需要在目标领域进行培训来进行推论. 近年来提出了各种各样的愿景基础模型。 DINO [7]和EVA [8]是地物取出主干线的流行例子,可以为下游的各种任务进行精细的调制. SAM [9]和地基SAM [10]是为分块任务而设计的. 双子座[11]和Quen VL [12]等大型视觉语言模型支持图像输入,但它们都接受了更高水平的图像理解和推理培训,而不是像素水平分解任务.

blocks.en: Another recent trend has been the deveploment of open vocabulary models to allow segmenting images with arbitary prompts. SAM3 [ 3 ] added support to query masks with short open vocabulary concenpts. DINO.txt [ 13 ] aligns dense DINO features with text prompt encodings to to allow open vocabulary segmentation. OpenSeg [ 4 ] employs a separate mask proposal network that generates class agnostic masks proposals that are then classified based on the feature similarity with the encoded text prompts.
blocks.zh: 最近的另一个趋势是开放词汇模型的解析,以便用仲裁提示来分解图像。 SAM3 [3] 增加了对有短开口词汇contepts的查询口罩的支持. DINO.txt [13] 将稠密的 DINO 特性与文本提示编码相协调,以便允许开放的词汇分割. OpenSeg [4] 采用了单独的口罩建议网络,生成类不可知口罩建议,然后根据特征与编码文本提示的相似性进行分类.

blocks.en: II-B Zero-shot segmentation in 3D
blocks.zh: II-B 三维零发分片

blocks.en: Traditional supervised 3D segmentation networks are trained to produce semantic labels from the pointcloud with manually labeled dataset. For zero-shot methods a common approach is to predict features or segmentation masks from the image with vision foundation models and lift them to 3D with known calibration [ 14 , 15 ] . Image based foundation models provide better zero-shot open vocabulary performance thanks to better training data availability, most importantly image-caption pairs. Image foundation models can also serve as supervision to distill 3D prediction models [ 16 , 17 ] enabling zero-shot open-vocabulary segmentation from 3D inputs alone, while also allowing image and 3D modalities to be fused for improved performance. However, the performance gains are limited as the 3D model relies on the image model for supervision leading to correlated outputs.
blocks.zh: 传统的受监督的3D分块网络被训练出用手动标注的数据集从点云产生语义标签. 对于零射出的方法,一个常见的方法是用视觉基础模型预测图像的特征或分解口罩,并用已知的校正[14,15]将其提升到3D. 基于图像的基础模型通过更好的培训数据可用性,提供了更好的零镜头开放词汇性能,最重要的是图像封装对. 图像基础模型还可以作为分解3D预测模型[16,17]的监理,使得仅从3D输入中就可以进行零发开伏分解,同时也允许将图像和3D模式相接来提高性能. 然而,由于3D模型依赖图像模型进行监督,导致产出相互关联,因此绩效收益有限。

blocks.en: II-C Zero-shot segmentation in offroad
blocks.zh: II-C 外出零发分射

blocks.en: Offroad conditions pose spesific challenges to zero-shot segmentation in both 3D and image modalities. Images lack easily identifiable salient objects and most foundation model training data is from structured scenes which leads to decreased performance in offroad environments. In 3D, points don’t necessarily form dense easily identifiable clusters as in the common 3D segmentation benchmarks like ScanNet [ 18 ] and Matterport3D [ 19 ] . Instead the point density is singificantly lower and shapes more irregular.
blocks.zh: 路外条件对三维和图像模式的零射入分化提出了巨大的挑战。 图像缺乏易于识别的显要对象,大多数基础模型培训数据来自结构化场景,导致越野环境中的性能下降. 在3D中,点不一定像ScanNet [18] 和Matterport3D [19] 等常见的3D分化基准那样,形成密集而易于识别的集群. 取而代之的是分点密度低而成形更不规则.

blocks.en: Very limited research has been conducted to solve zero-shot semantic segmentation in offroad conditions. Instead, most works concentrate on estimating just the traversability in a self-supervised manner [ 1 , 2 ] . However, such approaches can’t effectively handle scenarios where the platform needs to navigate over variety of terrain, obstacles and vegetation with different passability. 3D semantic maps are also inheritly platform agnostic unlike most self-supervised traversability estimation methods. Traversability is property tied to a specific platform while 3D semantic mapping is an objective description of the environment.
blocks.zh: 为解决偏僻条件下的零射入语义分解问题进行了非常有限的研究. 相反,大多数工作集中在以自我监督的方式估计可转性[1,2]。 然而,这些方法无法有效处理平台需要穿越不同地形、障碍和植被、具有不同可通行性的情景。 3D语义图也继承了平台不可知论,与大多数自监督的可转性估计方法不同.  traversity是属性绑定在一个特定平台上,而3D语义映射则是对环境的客观描述.

blocks.en: Best of our knowledge OTAS [ 20 ] is the only work aiming to specifically address the issue of zero-shot semantic segmentation in offroad conditions. They demonstrate that dense CLIP [ 21 ] features commonly used for open vocabulary segmentation are noisy in the offroad scenario. To solve this problem they extract dense DINOv2 features that are visually more robust and cluster them to form mask proposals. These mask proposals are then classified using their average CLIP feature. In the 3D case the point coordinates are concatenated with the features before clustering to encourage spatial coherency.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知 OTAS [20] 是专门解决在外出条件下零射语义分离问题的唯一工作。 他们证明,通常用于开放词汇分解的密集的CLIP[21]特征在越野场景中很吵. 为了解决这个问题,它们提取了视觉上更坚固的稠密的DINOv2特性,并将其组合起来形成遮掩建议. 这些口罩提案随后会使用它们的平均CLIP特性进行分类. 在3D情况下,点坐标与地物相接后再组合,以鼓励空间一致性。

blocks.en: II-D Geometric features in offroad robotics
blocks.zh: II-D 越野机器人的几何特征

blocks.en: Geometric features have been long used for evaluating the environment properties in offroad conditions. Common features are step-height, roughness and slope [ 22 ] . These features work well in solid terrain, but not when passing through vegetation is required. High vegetation typically has high roughness and step height leading to classification as obstacle. Utilization of linearity, planarity and sphericity features is one proposed solution to this problem [ 23 , 24 ] . Vegetation typically has high sphericity, whereas terrain and structures exhibit high planarity, and thin obstacles high linearity.
blocks.zh: 几何特征长期以来一直用于评估非公路条件下的环境特性。 常见的特征有步高,粗糙和坡度[22]. 这些地貌在坚实的地貌中运作良好,但在需要经过植被时则不起作用. 高植被通常具有高粗糙度和步高,导致被归类为障碍. 利用线性、计划性和球面性特征是解决这一问题的一个拟议解决办法。 植被通常具有高球面,而地形和结构则具有高度的可规划性,而细小的障碍则具有高线性。

blocks.en: II-E Research Gap
blocks.zh: 二-E 研究差距

blocks.en: We improve zero-shot 3D semantic mapping by utilizing geometric priors based on elevation and sphericity extracted from lidar point clouds. Refrence elevation-sphericity histogram is fitted for each class utilizing the points with most confident vision foundation model predictions. The fitting process is lightweight and the histogram describes the geometrical separation of different classes in human understandable form. In existing works, OTAS utilizes 3D coordinates to improve spatial segmentation coherency but ignores other cues available from geometry [ 20 ] . On the other hand, distilling 3D networks with image based foundation model supervision requires environment specific neural network training that is time and computation heavy. [ 16 , 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们通过利用从立达点云中提取的几何前缀来改进零射三维语义绘图。 利用最有把握的视觉基础模型预测的分数,为每类都安装了反光-球面直方图。 相配过程为轻量级,直方图以人类可理解的形式描述了不同类的几何分化. 在现有作品中,OTAS使用3D坐标来改进空间分化一致性,但忽略了从几何学上可以得到的其他提示 [20]. 另一方面,将基于图像的基础模型监督的3D网络蒸馏,需要对环境进行时间和计算重的神经网络特定培训. [16,17].

blocks.en: III Methods
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: Fig. 2 : Geometric prior computation and utilization illustrated. The most confident image segmentation predictions are used to fit the sphericity-elevation distributions for each class, which are then used to assign prior weights for each point in the fusion phase.
blocks.zh: 图2:显示几何计算和使用情况。 最有自信的图像分解预测用来配合每个类的球状-外延分布,然后用来分配聚变相中每个点的先前重量.

blocks.en: Given a synced lidar scan-image sequence our method generates a semantic pointcloud map of the sequence. The method is divided to four parts. First confidence score maps are generated for each class using an open vocabulary vision foundation model (Section III-A ). Then sphericity and elevation are computed for the 3D point cloud map accumulated from the posed scans (Section III-B ). Then sphericity-elevation histogram is fitted using the points with most confident vision foundation model predictions (Section III-C ). Finally, the geometric prior is queried from the fitted histograms and fused with the vision foundation model confidence maps to produce the final segmentation output (Section III-D ).
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个同步的Lidar扫描-图像序列,我们的方法生成一个序列的语义点云图. 方法分为四部分. 使用开放式词汇视觉基础模型(第三节A节)为每门课生成第一次信心分数图。 然后计算出从所提交的扫描中积累的3D点云图的球面和高地(第三节-B节)。 然后利用最有自信的视觉基础模型预测的点来安装球-外延直方图(第三节-C节)。 最后,从装配的直方图中询问前几何图,并与视觉基础模型信任图相接以产生最终分解输出(第三节-D节)。

blocks.en: III-A Zero-shot open vocabulary image segmentation
blocks.zh: III-A 零射开口词汇图像分割

blocks.en:
We employ an open vocabulary vision foundation model for the image segmentation task. Given an open vocabulary prompt the model outputs a score for each pixel or image patch describing the correspondence with that prompt. To define a class wise score distribution each image is prompted with all the class names in the dataset yielding confidence score map 𝐒 img t ∈ ℝ H × W × C \mathbf{S}_{\text{img}}^{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C} at each timestep t t , where H , W H,W is the image size and C C number of semantic classes.
We then project the lidar scan from timestep t t to the image frame based on known intrinsic and extrinsic calibration and retrieve the semantic information from the corresponding pixels yielding pointwise confidence score map 𝐒 scan t ∈ ℝ n × C \mathbf{S}_{\text{scan}}^{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times C} , where n n is the number of points in the scan. Points that are outside the camera field of view are discarded. Points are accumulated across the sequence based on known poses to form a confidence score point cloud map 𝐒 map ∈ ℝ N × C \mathbf{S}_{\text{map}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times C} , where N N is total number of scan points in the sequence. A corresponding 3D cloud map P map ∈ ℝ N × 3 \textbf{P}_{\text{map}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times 3} is also formed.
blocks.zh:
我们为图像分解任务采用了开放式词汇视觉基础模型. 由于一个开放的词汇提示模型会输出每个像素或图像补丁的分数来描述与该提示的对应. 要定义一个类明智分数分布,每个图像都会被提示使用数据集中所有类名生成信任分数图 S img t → → R H → W → C mathbf{ S}_{\text{img}}^{t}\in\ mathbb{ R}^{H\times W\times C}在每个时间步 t t, 其中H,W H,W是图像大小和C C 语义类数.
然后根据已知的内在和外在校正,将lidar扫描从时间步 t 到图像框架进行投影,从相应的像素中取出语义信息,产生出点信任分数图 S扫描 t → R n → mathbf{ S}_{\text{ scan}}^{t}\in\ mathbb{ R}^{n\times C},其中n是扫描中点数. 相机视野外的点被丢弃. 积分在已知的姿势基础上跨序相通,形成信任分数分数分数相通的云映射 S 地图相通 R N × C \ mathbf{ S}_{\text{map}}\in\ mathbb{R}^{N\times C},其中N N是序列中扫描分数的总数. 相适应的 三维云图 P 地图 QQ R N × 3\ textbf{ P}_{\text{ map}}\in\ mathbb{ R}^{N\times 3 } 也组成了。

blocks.zh: 三-B 球面和高程计算

blocks.zh: 三-C 相接类直方图

blocks.en: We model the geometric properties of each class with 2D histograms that can accurately capture arbitrary shapes unlike parametric distributions. For elevation, we define non-uniform bins E i E_{i} utilizing a 0.1 m bin spacing for values between 0–1 m, and a 1.0 m bin spacing for values exceeding 1 m. For sphericity, we define uniform bins S j S_{j} with a 0.05 spacing across the entire [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] range. To fit the distribution for a given class c c , we utilize only the most confident predictions to avoid incorporating noisy samples. Let 𝒫 5 % c \mathcal{P}_{5\%}^{c} denote this high-confidence subset, consisting of the top 5% most confident points among all points where class c c is the highest-scoring prediction from the vision foundation model. Let i i be the elevation bin index and j j be the sphericity bin index. The unnormalized occurrence count h c ​ ( i , j ) h^{c}(i,j) for class c c is computed by accumulating the points in 𝒫 5 % c \mathcal{P}_{5\%}^{c} that fall into the respective bins: h c ​ ( i , j ) = α + ∑ 𝐩 ∈ 𝒫 5 % c 𝟙 ​ ( e 𝐩 ∈ E i ∧ s 𝐩 ∈ S j ) , h^{c}(i,j)=\alpha+\sum_{\mathbf{p}\in\mathcal{P}_{5\%}^{c}}\mathbbm{1}\Big(e_{\mathbf{p}}\in E_{i}\land s_{\mathbf{p}}\in S_{j}\Big), (4) where 𝟙 ​ ( ⋅ ) \mathbbm{1}(\cdot) is the indicator function, and α = 1 \alpha=1 is the initial count added to every bin to avoid zero counts that veto out that class. Finally, we normalize the accumulated counts to sum to one across the histogram: h norm c ​ ( i , j ) = h c ​ ( i , j ) ∑ u ∑ v h c ​ ( u , v ) , h^{c}_{\text{norm}}(i,j)=\frac{h^{c}(i,j)}{\sum_{u}\sum_{v}h^{c}(u,v)}, (5) where u u and v v iterate over all elevation and sphericity bins, respectively. The fitted histograms for each class in the Rellis3D and WildScenes datasets are presented in Figures 4 and 5 .

blocks.en: III-E Validation
blocks.zh: 三-E 审定

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed method using three zero-shot, open-vocabulary image segmentation models: DINOv2.txt, SAM 3, and OpenSeg. Given a text prompt, SAM 3 outputs a set of mask proposals, each paired with a mask score in the range [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] representing the model’s confidence in that mask, as well as a pixel-wise score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] indicating the confidence that each pixel belongs to that mask. We define the final per-pixel confidence score as the product of the global mask score and the pixel-wise mask score. DINOv2.txt employs a ViT-L/14 backbone with registers alongside its corresponding vision head and text encoder. OpenSeg uses an EfficientNet-B7 backbone paired with CLIP ViT-L/14@336px text embeddings, following OpenScene [ 16 ] . For both DINOv2.txt and OpenSeg, we scale the raw cosine similarities between the text prompt embeddings and visual embeddings by a temperature of T = 100 T=100 before applying a softmax function, consistent with the CLIP training recipe.All models operate at their respective recommended input resolutions: SAM 3 inputs are stretched directly to 1008 × 1008 ​ px 1008\times 1008\text{ px} , OpenSeg inputs are resized to a 640 ​ px 640\text{ px} long side while preserving the aspect ratio, with the short side padded to 640 ​ px 640\text{ px} and DINOv2.txt inputs are resized to a 224 ​ px 224\text{ px} short side while preserving the aspect ratio.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三个零镜头、可公开的图像分解模型评估拟议方法:DINOv2.txt、SAM 3和OpenSeg。 由于文字提示,SAM 3输出出一组口罩建议,每组口罩分数为[0, 1] [0, 1] ,代表模型对口罩的信心,并用 [0, 1] [0, 1] 来表示每个口罩属于的自信. 我们把最终的每像素信心分数定义为全球口罩分数和像素-明智口罩分数的产品. DINOv2.txt使用一个ViT-L/14主干线,与相应的视觉头和文本编码器相配有登记册. OpenSeg使用高效Net-B7主干线与CLIP ViT-L/14@336px文本嵌入对接,跟随OpenScene [16]. 对DINOv2.txt和OpenSeg来说,在应用软max函数之前,我们先将文本即时嵌入和视觉嵌入的原始同位素相似度以T = 100 T = 100的温度来标出,这与CLIP训练配方一致. 所有模型都按各自推荐的输入分辨率运行: SAM 3输入被直接拉伸到1008×1008x1008\times 1008\text{ px}, OpenSeg输入被调整为640px 640\text{ px} 长边,同时保留了侧相比,短边被加到640px 640\text{ px}和 DINov2.txt输入被调整为224px 224\text{ px} 短边.

blocks.en: Additionally, we compare against OTAS, which is specifically designed for zero-shot 3D semantic segmentation in unstructured environments. For each feature patch, we assign the median depth of all LiDAR scan points projecting into that patch. Following the authors’ recommended configuration, we use the spatial variant of OTAS with 24 clusters, 24 components, a DINOv2 ViT-S/14 backbone with registers, and a 224 ​ px 224\text{ px} input resolution, setting the voxel size to 0.2 ​ m 0.2\text{ m} to match our method’s resolution. The reconstructed map is queried with every dataset class prompt, and each 3D point is assigned the class yielding the highest similarity score. To keep GPU memory consumption manageable, the map is processed in chunks of 500 samples.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们与OTAS进行比较,后者是专门为无结构环境中的零射出3D语义分解而设计的. 对于每个功能补丁,我们指定所有LiDAR扫描点投射到该补丁的中位深度. 按照作者推荐的配置, 我们使用 OTAS 的空间变体, 包含 24 个集群, 24 个组件, 一个 DINOv2 ViT-S/14 的主干线, 以及 224 px 224\text{ px} 输入分辨率, 将 voxel 大小设定为 0.2 m 0.2\text{ m} 来匹配我们方法的分辨率 。 重构的地圖被以每个数据集类的快取来询问,每个3D分被分配到产生最高相似分的类. 为了保持GPU内存消耗的可控性,地图被以500个样本块处理.

blocks.en: III-F Data
blocks.zh: 三-F 数据

blocks.en: We evaluate our method using the WildScenes [ 6 ] and Rellis3D [ 5 ] datasets. Both include image-lidar scan pairs with known calibration and ground truth for pointcloud semantics. We only consider the lidar scan points that are inside the camera field of view as all evaluated methods require image data in addition to the 3D points. Lidar points further than 25 m are filtered out as alignment errors increase and sensor resolution decreases with longer distances.
blocks.zh: 我们使用WildScens[6]和Rellis3D[5]数据集来评估我们的方法. 两者都包括有已知校正的图像-lidar扫描对和指向点云语义的地真. 我们只考虑相机视野内的lidar扫描点,因为所有被评价的方法除了3D点外还需要图像数据. 随着对齐误差的增加和传感器分辨率随着距离的延长而降低,超过25米的Lidar点被过滤出.

blocks.en: WildScenes is collected on Australian forest trails surrounded by high tree canopies. We exclude ambigous classes: other-terrain , other-object and unlabelled . We also exclude sky and water as these labels are not present in the 3D data.
blocks.zh: 野生景物被收集在被高树冠所包围的澳大利亚森林小径上. 我们排除了异乎寻常的阶级:其他的种族、其他对象和无标签的阶级。 我们还排除了天空和水,因为这些标签没有出现在三维数据中。

blocks.en: RELLIS3D is collected on rural fields and trails in Texas dominated by grass, bushes and smaller trees. We exclude ambigous classes void and object . We exclude sky as it is not present in the 3D data and person and vehicle as they are dynamic. We also exclude building and dirt as no points belonging to these classes are retained with the camera fov filtering with 25 m max distance used here. The poses were computed with kiss-icp [ 25 ] .
blocks.zh: RELLIS3D被收集到德克萨斯州以草地,灌木和小树为主的农村田地和小道上. 我们排除了无足轻重的阶级, 我们排除了天空,因为它没有存在于三维数据和人与飞行器中,因为它们是动态的。 我们还排除建筑和泥土,因为没有属于这些类的分数被保留下来,用相机最宽25米的距离过滤。 姿势是用亲吻来计算的 [25].

blocks.en: IV Results
blocks.zh: 四. 结果

blocks.en:
Accuracy, mIoU and class wise IoU are reported for each model on Rellis3D dataset (Table I ) and WildScenes dataset (Table II ). The geometry prior improves performance for all benchmarked zero-shot segmentation models.
SAM3 is the best performing baseline model achieving 28.1 mIoU and 73.9 accuracy on Rellis3d and 47.9 mIoU and 80.5 accuracy on WildScenes. With the geometry prior SAM3 achieves +6.3 mIoU and +8.9 accuracy increase on Rellis3d and +1.7 mIoU and +2.1 accuracy increase on WildScenes.
On Rellis3d the classes with highest gains are Bush (+44.2), Grass (+8.8), Puddle (+5.2) and Water (+28.7) and on WildScenes Bush (+3.8), Dirt (+7.9) and Grass (+9.2). OTAS often confuses similar classes, like dirt and gravel or tree-foliage and tree-trunk and achieves slightly lower accuracy than the DINOv2.txt and OpenSeg baselines. Qualitative examples for OTAS, SAM3 and SAM3 with geometric priors are presented in Tables III and IV .
blocks.zh:
Rellis3D数据集(表一)和WildScens数据集(表二)的每个模型都报告准确性、mIoU和类智IoU。 几何学前改进了所有基准零发分片模型的性能.
SAM3是表现最佳的基准模型,在Rellis3d和47.9mIoU上达到28.1mIoU和73.9精度,在WildScens上达到80.5精度. 随着前作"SAM3"的几何学,Rellis3d的精度得到+6.3 mIoU和+8.9的精度提高,WildScens的精度得到+1.7 mIoU和+2.1.
在Rellis3d上,收益最高的阶层是:布什(+44.2),草(+8.8),普德(+5.2)和水(+28.7),在野生景地布什(+3.8),地特(+7.9)和草(+9.2). OTAS经常会混淆出相类似的类,如泥土和砾石或树叶和树-trunk,并达到略低于DINOv2.txt和OpenSeg基线的精度. 表三和表四列出了OTAS、SAM3和SAM3具有几何前身的定性实例。

blocks.en: For further analysis, we ablate different smoothing factors and the performance of only sphericity or elevation based prior histograms (Table V ). With both datasets the joint elevation-sphericity prior outperforms either component alone. Optimal smoothing factor depends on the quality of the image predictions as it controls how much weight the geometry is given over the image predictions. Smoothing factor 0.25 was found to provide the best compromise across both datasets and is used with all reported results here. In most cases, any choice of the smoothing factor provided significant improvements over the baseline.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步分析,我们减少不同的平滑因子,并只减少以前方直方图为基础的球形或高地的性能(表五)。 这两种数据集都表明,联合高地-球面的优胜率高于任何一个组件。 最佳平滑因子取决于图像预测的质量,因为它控制了几何在图像预测上的分量. 平滑系数0.25被认为为两个数据集提供了最佳的折中方案,并用于此处报告的所有结果。 在多数情况下,对平滑因素的任何选择都比基线大有改进。

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: This paper introduced a method to improve zero-shot segmentation in offroad scenes with geometric priors computed from the 3D data. The geometric priors increased performance especially on natural classes like bush, grass, dirt, water and puddle while performance on structured classes was very little affected. Our explanation for this behavior is two-fold. First, the zero-shot vision foundation models are more prone to make mistakes on natural classes due to the limited training data from these domains, leaving more room for improvement. Second, the elevation-sphericity histogram has better separation between natural classes than between structured ones. In Figure 4 , barrier, fence and pole all share quite similar distributions while grass, bush and tree are more clearly separated.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了一种方法,用从三维数据计算出的几何前缀来改进路外场景的零发分片. 几何前科的成绩增加,特别是在灌木、草地、泥土、水和水坑等自然阶层,而结构阶层的成绩则很少受到影响。 我们对这种行为的解释是双重的。 首先,由于这些领域的培训数据有限,零镜头视觉基础模型更容易出错于自然课,从而留下了更多的改进余地. 第二,高地-球面直方图在自然阶层之间比在结构阶层之间更好的分离。 在图4中,屏障、栅栏和柱子的分布都相当相近,而草地、灌木和树则比较明显。

blocks.en: While deep learning models can extract more complex features from 3D pointclouds, the proposed approach has a few main advantages over them. Deep learning models require training on each new environment while the distribution fitting process is much faster and requires less computation. Additionally, the proposed approach is more transparent: the geometric separation between classes can be directly evaluated from the fitted histograms. Finally, for many natural classes elevation and sphericity provide sufficient separation when fused with the vision foundation model predictions as the 3D shapes are simpler compared to cluttered indoor scenes.
blocks.zh: 虽然深层学习模型可以从3D点云中提取出更复杂的特征,但所拟议的方法比它们有一些主要优势. 深层学习模式需要就每个新环境进行培训,而分配适应过程则要快得多,需要较少的计算。 此外,拟议办法更加透明:可直接从装配直方图中评估各类别之间的几何分取。 最后,对于许多自然类的高地和球面,当与视觉基础模型预测相接时会提供足够的分离,因为相较于杂乱的室内场景,3D外形更为简单.

blocks.en: The performance of our method is limited by class separability within the histogram; consequently, classes sharing similar elevation and sphericity values cannot be distinguished. Furthermore, our approach relies on the vision foundation model to provide confident detections for each class in order to fit these distributions. Any bias or error on the vision foundation models detections affects the fitted histogram and consequentially the computed priors. In future work, more geometric features could be added to achieve more discriminative prior distributions or alternatively pre-trained point-encoders could be used to extract more complex point features. Another future challenge is calibrating the vision foundation model and geometric prior confidences for improved fusion and uncertainty estimation.
blocks.zh: 我们方法的性能受到直方图内类分化的限制;因此,分享类似高地和球面值的类无法区分. 此外,我们的方法依靠视觉基础模型,为每一类人提供自信的检测,以适应这些分布。 视觉基础模型检测的任何偏差或出错都会影响所安装的直方图并因此影响所计算的前科。 在今后的工作中,可以增加更多的几何特征,以实现更具有歧视性的前期分布,或者可以使用事先训练的点编码器来提取更复杂的点特征. 未来的另一个挑战是校正愿景基础模型和几何前置信心,以改进聚变和不确定性估计。

blocks.en: While histograms can capture arbitrary distribution shapes, they also introduce significant limitations. Specifically, a query bin’s prior depends solely on its own value, without accounting for neighboring bins. Consequently, an empty bin adjacent to high-density regions is treated identically to an empty bin in a sparse region. Future work could address this limitation by applying spatial smoothing to the histograms. Parameterized distributions, such as 2D Gaussians are also a potential solution but they also restrict the shape of the distribution.
blocks.zh: 虽然直方图可以捕捉任意分布形状,但也带来了显著的限制. 具体来说,一个查询宾的前身完全取决于它自己的价值,而不计入相邻的宾馆。 因此,与高密度地区相邻的空宾馆与人口稀少地区的空宾馆一样对待。 今后的工作可以通过对直方图进行空间平滑处理这一限制。 参数化的分布,如2D高斯克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克
